articles.title: Oscar-winning Star Wars editor Marcia Lucas dies aged 80
articles.description: The film editor and ex-wife of director George Lucas was widely recognised as a pivotal creative force behind the original space trilogy.

articles.title: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'alarming', charity warns, as WHO chief visits worst-hit area
articles.description: Médicins Sans Frontières says that never before has an Ebola outbreak recorded so many cases so soon after its declaration.

articles.title: Trump attacks artists dropping out of US Freedom 250 concert and mulls appearing himself
articles.description: Performers Young MC, Poison frontman Bret Michaels and country singer Martina McBride raised concerns the event will be political.

articles.title: Israel put on UN sexual violence in warzones blacklist for first time
articles.description: Israel says it rejects allegations in a new report by the office of the UN secretary general.

articles.title: Nato and EU condemn Russia after drone hits Romanian residential block
articles.description: Romania says the Russian drone was likely hit over Ukraine by its air defences and altered its trajectory.

articles.title: Eight students arrested in Kenya after suspected deadly school arson attack
articles.description: Sixteen pupils died in the fire that ripped through a dormitory while they were asleep.
